claim_register.claim: A Nostro account holds this bank’s funds at another bank. A Vostro account holds another bank’s funds at this bank. The source connects these accounts with settlement positions and reconciliation. The golden-source proposal distinguishes Nostro accounts held with another legal entity, over accounts within the same legal entity, and internal suspense accounts without payment or receipt. It groups all three under Nostro static.

No populated account examples are retained here.
